Comparable isolated dots are visible above L_0 and above the arrow. The pair is dark and close enough to resemble a small raised colon; the scan does not establish whether it is deliberate punctuation or accidental marks. rows.note: The raised pair may be an authorial mark or incidental specks; the scan does not decide. Retain the existing \unsure{:} rather than silently remove it or introduce an empty-set symbol that is not in the manuscript. Here b records that the proposed omission would be editorial removal of a possible authorial mark, not a securely established reading correction. This classification does not assert that the pair is intentional punctuation.
